items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: And, Ennis Band, and Earl Fosch here used to play saxophone with us, with Sam Morgan's band.

ctx.x: Um, how much did he charge for lessons? Do you remember?

Well, he was only charging, uh, a half a dollar for lessons. How often did you go? Once a week or twice? Well, then we could go, no, we was, we were taking lessons twice a week with him. Twice a week. Twice a week with him. That was the price, Ron, you know, on lessons at that time. 50 cents. 50 cents. So, Joe Watson, he gave me a lesson on the clarinet, well he didn't charge me anything. Pinchback Churro, well I paid him a half a dollar. David Jones, it was a half a dollar. And, Ennis Band, and Earl Fosch here…
Harold Dejan's always talking about him, he's wonderful. Yeah.
